definition.description: Measure latest reported gross margin (GrossProfit/revenue) minus the same fiscal window one year earlier. Anchor to latest canonical revenue end and shortest explicitly reported duration on a tied end, before requiring current profit or comparators. Require exact month-aligned 3/6/9/12-month windows and same currency; YTD compares identical YTD windows. Missing current/prior gross profit or revenue, zero revenue, unresolved required-window conflicts, stale current periods, unsupported stubs or 52/53-week calendars are unavailable; never replace the latest anchor with an older complete pair. Numeric change >=0.08 is positive, <=-0.02 negative, otherwise neutral; categories describe this measurement, not future returns. Preserve full literal operands and evidence. Default current freshness is 550 days; absolute change above 2 has partial coverage and confidence 0.5 without changing the measurement.

raw_retrieval.comparison_requirement: Latest reported gross margin minus the same fiscal window one year earlier; latest revenue anchor, shortest duration on ties. Exact 3/6/9/12-month boundaries and currency; missing profits, zero revenue or conflicts unavailable.
